meta.description: UI map of the generated production-ranges report. One template renders every report; most of the page is built by its inline script at runtime, so anchors point at the code that draws an element, not at static markup.
meta.generated: Read from templates/report.html on 2026-09-20. Every element carries a data-inspect-id (static markup) or dataset.inspectId (runtime-built), which is both the map anchor and the hook the inspector overlay reads.
meta.howToUse: locate.grep is a ready-to-paste grep command; run it from the repo root. locate.path is a secondary file:line reference that drifts as the file changes - the grep command does not.
meta.inspector: Attached to every report by scripts/serve_reports.py. Press the crosshair button, bottom right, to arm it. The button remembers its state across reloads. The overlay is injected per request and never written into the report files themselves.

nodes.label: Production ranges report
nodes.description: The single report template. Placeholders (__DATA__, __META__, __TARGET__, __TITLE__, __EYEBROW__, __HEADLINE__, __TARGET_ABS__) are string-replaced at build time; everything else is drawn client-side from DATA. The likeliest touchdown scorer is not baked in: scripts/serve_reports.py injects window.__TD__ at serve time, and the script tints that player's cards.

uiElements.label: Page container
uiElements.description: Outer 1120px column that everything on the report sits inside.

uiElements.label: Report header
uiElements.description: Top block holding the eyebrow line and the matchup headline.

uiElements.label: Kickoff eyebrow
uiElements.description: Kickoff time, week and season. Filled at build time from __EYEBROW__ in nflprops/report.py.

uiElements.label: Chart legend
uiElements.description: Explains the two team colours, the shaded middle-68% band, the dashed expected line, and the solid FanDuel line.

uiElements.label: Shortlist panel
uiElements.description: Black-bordered panel holding the ranked shortlist and its payout footer.

uiElements.label: Shortlist heading
uiElements.description: 'The shortlist' with the 'most confident first' unit label.

uiElements.label: Shortlist caveat
uiElements.description: States that confidence means likely, not mispriced. This is the disclaimer, not decoration.

uiElements.label: Shortlist list
uiElements.description: Empty <ol> in the template. Filled at runtime from every DATA row carrying a pick number.

uiElements.label: Shortlist row
uiElements.description: One leg: rank, player, bet and line, price, confidence percent.

uiElements.label: Payout footer
uiElements.description: Straight payout, naive joint chance, and the correlation note.

uiElements.label: Straight payout
uiElements.description: Product of every leg's decimal odds. Computed in the template's own script, not server-side.

uiElements.label: Naive joint chance
uiElements.description: Product of min(model, book) across legs. 'Naive' because it assumes independence.

uiElements.label: Correlation note
uiElements.description: Whether the legs share a game. Text chosen in nflprops/report.py and injected via META.corrnote.

uiElements.label: Stat sections container
uiElements.description: Empty div. Runtime appends one heading plus one card grid per stat in STATS.

uiElements.label: Stat section heading
uiElements.description: Stat name plus its unit, e.g. 'Rushing yards / yards'.

uiElements.label: Player card grid
uiElements.description: Responsive grid of player cards for one stat, ordered by how close the book's number sits to the curve's peak.

uiElements.label: Player card
uiElements.description: One player-stat projection. Gets a heavier border when it is a shortlist pick.

uiElements.label: Card player name
uiElements.description: Player name in the card's top row.

uiElements.label: Card role badge
uiElements.description: Team-coloured position badge, e.g. QB1 or WR2.

uiElements.label: Card pick badge
uiElements.description: Only present when the player is on the shortlist. Shows the pick's rank.

uiElements.label: Card expected value
uiElements.description: The projection's mu, after calibration.

uiElements.label: Card range
uiElements.description: The middle-68% band, mu plus or minus one sd, with sd already widened 10%.

uiElements.label: Card curve chart
uiElements.description: Inline SVG Gaussian. Built by curve() from mu and sd alone.

uiElements.label: Curve hover target
uiElements.description: Transparent rect that catches mousemove and drives the tooltip. The chart has no other pointer handling.

uiElements.label: Model vs book row
uiElements.description: FanDuel's line and price against the model's and book's implied probabilities.

uiElements.label: Model vs book, no line
uiElements.description: Shown instead of the comparison when no price near the target was offered for this player-stat.

uiElements.label: Peak offset note
uiElements.description: How many standard deviations separate the book's number from the curve's peak.

uiElements.label: Matchup note
uiElements.description: Defensive multiplier versus this position. Marked 'context only' for receiving stats, where applying it made projections worse.

uiElements.label: Curve tooltip
uiElements.description: Fixed-position readout that follows the cursor across a curve, showing a value and the chance of more.

uiElements.label: Full table disclosure
uiElements.description: Collapsed section holding every projected figure, not just the featured cards.

uiElements.label: Full table toggle
uiElements.description: Click target that expands the full figures table.

uiElements.label: Full figures table
uiElements.description: Every DATA row: player, role, stat, expected, minus and plus one sd, spread, matchup.

uiElements.label: Table row
uiElements.description: One player-stat row in the full table.

uiElements.label: Footer notes
uiElements.description: Four explanatory blocks: reading the matchup figure, curve width, model versus book, and the 'these are not edges' disclaimer.

uiElements.label: Touchdown scorer card
uiElements.description: The likeliest touchdown scorer's player card, washed in that player's team colour so the eye finds them before reading a name. Every card for that player is tinted, one per stat.

uiElements.label: Card touchdown badge
uiElements.description: Confidence chip on a tinted card, e.g. 'td 55%'. The lower of the model's number and the book's, the same rule every leg follows.

nodes.label: Report listing
nodes.description: The listing at /. Built by index_html() from the PAGE constant in this file -- there is no template. Weeks are tabs, left to right as played, newest selected. Cards are split into one block per kickoff time inside a week. Game cards deliberately mirror the player card in templates/report.html; if that card's anatomy moves, move this with it. The tab script is the separate TABS_JS constant, kept out of PAGE so its braces need no escaping.

uiElements.label: Listing container
uiElements.description: Outer 720px column holding the whole listing.

uiElements.label: Listing eyebrow
uiElements.description: Small monospace line above the title, matching the eyebrow on a report.

uiElements.label: Listing title
uiElements.description: The 'NFL Props' headline, in the same condensed face as a report's matchup headline.

uiElements.label: Listing subtitle
uiElements.description: Explains the tabs, the ordering, the TD marker, and that no edge is being claimed.

uiElements.label: Week tab strip
uiElements.description: Row of week tabs, reading left to right in the order the weeks were played. Arrow keys move between them, Home and End jump to the first and last.

uiElements.label: Week tab
uiElements.description: One week's tab, with that week's game count beside the label. The newest week sits on the right and is the one selected on load.

uiElements.label: Week panel
uiElements.description: The card grid for one week. Every panel but the selected one carries the hidden attribute.

uiElements.label: Game card
uiElements.description: One game's card, linking through to its report. Built on the same anatomy as a report's player card: label and badge on top, an oversized figure, a range line, then a dotted comparison row.

uiElements.label: Card game label
uiElements.description: The away-at-home pairing in the card's top row, where a player card puts the player's name.

uiElements.label: Card day badge
uiElements.description: Accent-coloured weekday, e.g. SUN. Sits where a player card puts the position badge. Absent when no schedule row exists.

uiElements.label: Card kickoff time
uiElements.description: Kickoff time as the card's headline figure, where a player card puts its projection. Falls back to 'kickoff unknown' rather than the file's timestamp.

uiElements.label: Card date line
uiElements.description: Timezone and date under the figure, where a player card puts its range.

uiElements.label: Empty listing message
uiElements.description: Replaces the tabs and panels entirely when no reports have been generated yet.

uiElements.label: Listing footer
uiElements.description: The standing disclaimer: projections, not edges, and less accurate than the market in testing.

uiElements.label: Kickoff block
uiElements.description: All the games that kick off at one time, e.g. every Sunday 1:00 PM game. A Sunday is four separate sittings, and one undivided grid hid that.

uiElements.label: Kickoff block label
uiElements.description: Day and time for one block, with its game count. Quieter than a week tab, louder than a card.
